reading.title: Mars-Jupiter Conjunction Under Scorpio Sun
overview: The Sun at 22° Scorpio forms a sextile to the Moon at 23° Capricorn while the Moon stands out of bounds and squares Venus stationing retrograde at 23° Libra. Mars at 25° Leo conjoins Jupiter at 26° Leo, with the Sun squaring both, and Venus sextiles the pair. Outer-planet contacts include Uranus at 4° Gemini retrograde trining Pluto at 3° Aquarius out of bounds, Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextiling Pluto, and Saturn at 9° Aries retrograde conjoining Neptune.

Mundane tradition reads the Mars-Jupiter conjunction as a signature of expansive campaigns that risk overreach, especially while squared by the Scorpio Sun. Venus stationing retrograde in its rulership suggests pauses or reviews in alliances and financial flows. The Uranus-Pluto trine and Neptune-Pluto sextile point to gradual shifts in collective structures and beliefs, while Mercury at 5° Scorpio squaring Pluto flags intense information contests.

The recent Scorpio new moon falls in the third house for the United States and the twelfth for Russia, Ukraine and Israel, placing emphasis on communications or hidden matters respectively. Saturn remains in fall and Neptune in fall, with several national charts receiving tight transits to angles or luminaries within two degrees.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while Jupiter and Mars oppose the natal Moon and Saturn sextiles natal Uranus. These contacts coincide with reporting on a planned Trump-Putin-Xi meeting and North Korean cyber activity, though the fair-test records show no reliable link between such transits and measurable events.

Neptune squares the natal Sun and Uranus squares the natal Moon while Pluto conjoins natal Saturn. The new moon sits in the twelfth house; reporting on Ukrainian strikes against energy nodes overlaps the Mars-Jupiter conjunction but records find no statistical edge over chance.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Jupiter conjoins natal Jupiter and Mercury with the new moon in the twelfth house. Continued deep-strike tempo aligns with the Mars-Jupiter conjunction in the lore, yet the tested correlation between Mars afflictions and daily alerts remains indistinguishable from chance.

Pluto conjoins the natal Moon and ASC while Saturn opposes the natal Sun. The new moon falls in the eighth house; Taiwan-related election markets and carrier transits appear in the overlaps, though no predictive accuracy is established in the records.

Saturn squares the natal Sun and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter with Jupiter square natal Venus. Election-market activity shows in the Uranus-Pluto and Uranus-Neptune overlaps, but the long-term tests report no improvement over random expectation.

reading.lore_and_intel: Mars-Jupiter conjunction and Sun square appear with Ukrainian strikes and certain Taiwan election markets at z-values above 3, while Uranus trine Pluto and Neptune sextile Pluto coincide with protest and election reporting; Venus sextile Mars overlaps labour and carrier items. No such overlaps exist for the Israel or Iran charts in the supplied reporting, and every tested claim—MARS afflictions versus alerts or losses, full moons versus alerts, eclipses or lunations versus earthquakes—returns results no better than chance across thousands of days.

watch.note: Sun enters Sagittarius, shifting emphasis from Scorpio intensity to broader policy themes.
Full Moon at Gemini 2° may highlight communications or data releases.
Mars enters Virgo, moving from Leo conjunction to more precise or critical action.
Saturn stations direct, potentially clarifying structures that have been under review.

reading.the_test: Records covering 1685 to 9778 days show Mars afflictions versus Ukraine or Israel alerts and Russian losses perform no better than chance, with differences of -1% to +2% and corrected p-values of 1.00. Full moons, new moons and eclipses likewise yield no reliable elevation in alerts or earthquakes. The tested claims therefore supply no evidence that the listed configurations predict measurable events.
